info.title: Nitid Studio local API
info.summary: Contract v1 between the Nitid Studio frontend and the local FastAPI backend.
info.description: Hand-written contract used to build the frontend and backend in parallel. The definitive openapi.json is generated by FastAPI; the frontend generates its types from it and CI fails if the two diverge. Auth: per-launch bearer token in `Authorization`, plus Host/Origin validation. No accounts, no telemetry. Errors share one body: {"error": {"code", "message"}}.

servers.description: Relative to the origin serving Studio (127.0.0.1).

get.description: No authentication. The hosted (browser-only) frontend detects the absence of this endpoint and switches to browser mode.

post.summary: Start a checkpoint download (registry ids only)
post.description: Only ids with source=registry. Returns 404 for an unknown id (or an id without official weights for the requested task), 409 for a local model or a download already running, and 422 when the `task` query parameter is missing or not one of the Task values.

Limits per image: 25 MB and 20 Mpx. Larger inputs are rejected with 413 payload_too_large before any decoding. Accepted formats: JPEG, PNG, WEBP and BMP (sniffed from the bytes, not from the declared content type); anything else, including video, is 415 unsupported_media_type. At most 50 files per run. 422 invalid_params covers a bad `params` document, an unknown model or one without weights for the task, an unavailable backend or an unknown device. 409 conflict means the model is an official one that has not been downloaded yet (see POST /models/{id}/download). Runs execute one at a time in submission order; a queued run reports `pending`. `item_count` is the number of uploaded files; `items` fills as they are processed.

delete.summary: Delete a run and its files

get.description: The input image as stored; overlays are drawn client-side from the item JSON [decision, reversible].

get.summary: Images, JSON and CSV as a ZIP

get.description: Same body as the ONNX descriptor plus `sha256` (the value of the ETag of the binary).

parameters.name: imgsz
parameters.description: Square input size; defaults to the model's default size [NV].

get.description: The ETag is a strong validator whose opaque value is the lowercase sha256 of the body, i.e. `"<hex64>"` (quoted as HTTP requires). `If-None-Match` is honoured and yields 304.

parameters.name: imgsz
parameters.description: Square input size; defaults to the model's default size [NV].

bearerAuth.description: Token generated at each launch of `nitid studio`.

Forbidden.description: Host or Origin header not allowed.

Conflict.description: Operation not valid in the current state (local model, download already running, model not downloaded).

error.message: Model is local; nothing to download.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: File is not a supported image/video.

InvalidParams.description: A request parameter (or the `params` field of a multipart request) failed validation.

code.description: Stable machine-readable snake_case code. Used by the backend: unauthorized (401), forbidden_host and forbidden_origin (403), not_found (404), method_not_allowed (405), conflict (409), payload_too_large (413), unsupported_media_type (415), invalid_params (422), internal_error (500).

api_version.description: Major version of this contract (1 for /api/v1).

Model.description: One (id, task) pair. The same registry id (e.g. nitid1s) appears once per task it supports.

size.description: Size letter for registry models; null for user ONNX where it is unknown.

RunParams.description: JSON carried in the `params` multipart field of POST /runs. Unknown keys are rejected (422). Defaults when omitted: conf 0.25, iou 0.85, imgsz 640, classes null, mask_threshold 0.5, device null (backend default), frame_step 1. `frame_step` is accepted but unused until video input exists.

classes.description: Class ids to keep; null keeps all.

device.description: Device name from GET /devices (e.g. cpu, cuda:0, CPU, GPU, NPU); null = backend default.

frame_step.description: For video input: process every Nth frame.

Box.description: xyxy in pixels of the ORIGINAL item image (not the model input).

segments.description: Optional outline of the mask for task=segment (largest contour, pixels of the ORIGINAL image). Present only when has_mask is true. Same shape as `Results.to_json()` in the Python API.

id.description: Zero-based; equals the {n} of the /items/{n} endpoints.

Run.description: `item_count` is the number of uploaded files; `items` holds the results processed so far (all of them once status is done).

RunItemResult.description: Same shape as one element of Run.items.

OnnxMeta.title: NitidOnnxMeta
OnnxMeta.description: Descriptor that accompanies a nitid ONNX export. It carries what the ONNX graph cannot: class names and the preprocessing contract. `sha256` is optional and only ever added by the REST API (never embedded in the ONNX file, since it would change the hash it describes).

model.description: Model id, e.g. nitid1s, or any label for a user ONNX.

shape.description: Static [1, 3, S, S]; S must equal `imgsz` (checked semantically, not expressible in JSON Schema).

resize.description: Resize((S, S)) without preserving aspect ratio.

names.description: Class names keyed by decimal class id. Free-form map: no additionalProperties:false here.
